ITA-5.76.23 vamana-atiyogaḥ वमन-अतियोगः
Condition due to excessive therapeutic emesis

ITA-5.76.21 vamana-apacāraḥ वमन-अपचारः
Condition due to improper emetic therapy

ITA-5.76.22 vamana-ayogaḥ वमन-अयोगः
Condition of incomplete emetic therapy

ITA-5.76.40 vamana-vyāpadaḥ वमन-व्यापदः
Condition of improper administration of emetic therapy

ITA-9.6.211 vamanakarma वमनकर्म
Removal of foreign body by emesis
The removal of a loosely impacted foreign body by emesis.

ITA-5.76.108 vamitaviriktayostu āsthāpanasya vyāpadaḥ वमितविरिक्तयोस्तु आस्थापनस्य व्यापदः
Condition caused by medicated decoction enema administered to person who has just taken emetic therapy and purgation therapy
A condition characterized by administration of niruha vasti which burns the dehydrated body as if ulcerated by application of alkalis.

ITA-9.5.79 vāmakadhūmapānam वामकधूमपानम्
Medicated smoking with emetic effect
The procedure of medicated smoking to remove morbid dosha through the oral cavity.
